chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Mouth-rinsing and nasal inhalation are not required of you, because they are part of the interior.

key_terms.الْجَوْفِ: the internal cavity or interior of the body
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ: it is not obligatory upon you

ai.seo_question: Are mouth-rinsing and nasal inhalation obligatory in ghusl from janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning taharah from janabah: rinsing the mouth and drawing water into the nose are not obligatory. The reason given is that both pertain to the inner cavity, indicating they are not required elements of the external washing in ghusl.
